Name: X Xian's SnowpeakSparkle Window And Balcony(Dynamic and Weather Effects)
Author: Xiaoxian1102
Description:
Furniture includes:

[list=1]
[*]Dynamic snow-capped mountains and shimmering lakes

[*]Scenery changes with the four seasons and weather

[*]Includes a terrace and 2 floor-to-ceiling windows

[/list]Required dependencies :

[list=1]
[*]       Content Patcher (CP)
[*]        SMAPI
[/list]

This is a furniture & window mod.
You can purchase it from Robin or the Window category in the Furniture Catalog.

Have fun playing!





家具包括：
[list=1]
[*]动态的雪山与波光粼粼的湖泊 
[*]风景随四季与天气变化
[*]包含一个露台与两个落地窗
[/list]
前置模组 :[list=1]
[*]       Content Patcher (CP)
[*]        SMAPI
[/list]这是一个家具窗户类MOD，请在罗宾或者家具目录里面窗户类别购买。

祝你们玩得开心！
